Ignored executed root bundle has null Git mode and explicit generated-ignored tracking.
inclusions: Every pre-cleanup tracked object plus all three new owned metadata files (excluding exactly two future outputs), exact tracked gitlink, symlink targets, generated Mikro distribution and actual ignored executed dist/genie.js; archived entries represented explicitly as deletions. No source/runtime/test/config/package/lock/experiment directory exclusion.
